verdict.rationale: New Relic documents AI-powered summaries of workload health, performance trends, and potential issues (AI insights). Its New Relic AI assistant lets users troubleshoot issues and explore telemetry in plain language. Together these imply AI help for responders, but nothing shows summaries tied specifically to incidents or alert notifications. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident/issue summaries, AI enrichment of alert context delivered to responders, documentation of how summaries attach to alerts or notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
